start_here: Say to your AI: "Show me my Business screen: what my business took in this month on the payment services I connected." It reads the row of tool:business, which draws what tool:read-business read from my Stripe connection.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: the screen draws the money that tool:read-business reads this month from your connected payment services, and it writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Connect a payment service first (Stripe) in Connections; without one the screen sends you there.

2. Open the Business screen at /work/api/screens/business in the app, or ask your AI to read the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:business"} and to run tool:read-business (input {now?}) for the facts.

3. Read each connected service's block, headed "<service> since <first of the month>": money in, fees, refunded and net for each currency, and the payment count; a service it could not read says so with no number.
4. Where the figures count only the latest entries (100), the screen says there were more this month.

worked_examples.title: One Stripe payment this month
worked_examples.ask: Show me what my business took in this month.
worked_examples.given: From tools/see-what-my-business-took-in-this-month/test/business-screen.test.mjs and its golden test/fixtures/business-descriptions.json (case 4): Stripe is connected and read since October 1 with one US dollar payment of 10000 cents with 320 cents of fees, 0 refunded and 9680 net, 1 payment, not truncated. The layout of tool:business (one read, business, of tool:read-business) draws it.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"title":"Business","lead":"What your business took in this month.","sections":[{"heading":"Stripe since October 1","stats":[{"id":"in:usd","label":"Money in","value":"$100"},{"id":"fees:usd","label":"Stripe fees","value":"$3.20"},{"id":"net:usd","label":"Net","value":"$96.80"},{"id":"payments","label":"Payments","value":"1"}]}]}. With no payment service connected it is one row, "No payment service is connected", with the action Open Connections.
